headline: Shell Q3 Adjusted Profit Doubles to $10.8 Billion on Oil Price Surge
summary: Shell reported a third-quarter adjusted profit of $10.8 billion, doubling its previous quarter performance as Middle East conflict drove up oil and gas prices. The energy giant plans to return $5 billion to shareholders.
why: Shell is one of the world's largest integrated oil and gas supermajors, significantly influencing global energy markets.

impacts.name: Shell
impacts.why: Higher oil prices and doubled profits increase cash flow and dividend returns to shareholders.

why_moved: Dramatically increased profits and major shareholder returns drive demand for energy sector shares.
